map.0 至 1，标准化使不同表可比。: 0 to 1, and normalization makes different tables comparable.
map.Cramér's V 由卡方统计量 χ² 除以样本量与最小维度约束后开方得到，把: Cramér's V is obtained by taking the square root of the chi-square statistic divided by the sample size and the smaller dimension constraint, which normalizes the chi-square value into the range 0 to 1 and measures the strength of association between two categorical variables: 0 means no association and 1 means perfect association. It works for contingency tables of any size. This page computes it from the four cell frequencies of a 2x2 table.
map.Cramér's V 计算器：由列联表卡方值与样本量、自由度求 Cramér's: Cramér's V Calculator: derives Cramér's V effect size from the chi-square value, sample size and degrees of freedom to measure the strength of association between two categorical variables, for cross-tabulation analysis.
map.V = √(χ² / (n·min(r−1, c−1)))；r、c 为列联表行数: V = sqrt(χ² / (n*min(r-1, c-1))), where r and c are the numbers of rows and columns of the contingency table.
map.V 上界为何是 1？: Why is the upper bound of V 1?
map.χ² 随样本量增大，V 经 n 与维度标准化，便于跨表比较关联强度。: χ² grows with the sample size, while V is standardized by n and the dimensions, which makes association strength comparable across tables.
map.列联表关联强度：V=√(χ²/(n·min(r−1,c−1)))。: Strength of association in a contingency table: V=sqrt(χ²/(n*min(r-1,c-1))).
map.配合卡方检验显著性使用。: Use together with the chi-square test significance.
map.除以 n·min(r−1,c−1) 后，完全关联时 V=1，故恒在 [0,1]。: After dividing by n*min(r-1,c-1), V=1 for a perfect association, so it always lies in [0,1].
